name: Alcolea (Spain)
description: Divided by a wavy line, the upper part red with a yellow tower, the lower part four wavy stripes of white, green, white and blue.
history: The flag, the arms, an anagram and a slogan were approved by the municipal council of Alcolea on 11 October 2004 and admitted to the Andalusian register of local symbols on 13 January 2005; the flag is a cloth of 2:3 divided by a wavy line, the upper part red with a yellow tower and the lower part four wavy stripes of equal width, white, green, white and blue.
